name: 42437 · Morganfield, KY
findings: ZIP 42437 (Morganfield) has 20 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 42437 (Morganfield) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
43% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
